summary: At its Special meeting on May 25, 2021, the TTC Board considered the attached report titled “TTC Streetcar Program – Procurement of 60 Streetcars” and adopted the recommendation in the report, as follows: It is recommended the TTC Board: 1. Approve the following expenditure adjustments to the TTC’s 2021-2030 Capital Budget and Plan for the TTC Streetcar Program by: a. Increasing the 2021-2030 Approved Capital Budget and Plan by $425.785 million to a total of $568.0 million for the TTC Streetcar Program to reflect the procurement of an additional 47 streetcars at an incremental cost of $328.248 million, and the modifications to the Hillcrest Facility to accommodate the additional fleet at an additional cost of $97.537 million; and, b. Amending the 2021 Capital Budget and 2022-2027 cash flow funding estimates to align with the estimated project delivery schedule to the following: 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026 2027 Total 60 Streetcars 103,042 14,925 64,495 194,289 87,006 4,243 468,000 Hillcrest Facility 200 2,800 8,000 14,000 40,000 30,000 5,000 100,000 Total 103,242 17,725 72,495 208,289 127,006 34,243 5,000 568,000 2. Approve the following funding adjustments to offset the incremental expenditure increase of $425.785 million for the TTC Streetcar Program by: a.
